lines.zh: 我的尾尖在沙上划出线。
lines.en: My tail tip draws a line in the sand.
My upper body is held upright.
I glide over sand without prints.
My scales shine one by one in the light.
I move along the underground walls.
I keep my body in a straight line.
I turn a corner slowly.
My long hair falls past my waist.
I slip into a narrow passage.
My tail sweeps the bones on the floor.
I slide along the wall.
I stop beside a patch of light.
I coil my tail and sit.

lines.zh: 我的手指轻轻敲着石头。
lines.en: My fingers tap the stone.
Water drips in the cave.
I slowly turn my body away.
My hair lifts in the draft.

lines.zh: 我在听岩壁后面的动静。
lines.en: I'm listening beyond the rock.
I lift a hand and brush my hair aside.

lines.zh: 我的竖瞳在石影里亮起。
lines.en: My slit pupils light up in the stone shadow.
This place is very quiet.
I curl my tail around my side.
You've come in at a bad time.
I look up at you without smiling.

lines.zh: 我闻到你袖口的松脂味。
lines.en: I smell the resin on your sleeve.
I stand a little taller than you.
My tail lies right at your feet.
You stepped back once and stopped.
I tilt my head slightly.
Your hand rests on your weapon.
A patch of stone shadow lies between us.

lines.zh: 你看起来不像来送死的。
lines.en: You don't look like you've come to die.
My body listed to one side.
That blow forced me back half a step.
A mark has appeared on my scales.
I press a hand over the split in my scales.
I made not a single sound.
I draw my spine upright again.
My tail drew back.
There's a little blood in the torchlight.
I haven't left my spot.
I'll hold you to account for that.
I've no use for this at all.
I don't touch this kind of food.
What are you waiting for, holding it up?
The smell is far too faint.
I turned my head slowly away.
Your arm looks tired from holding it.
I don't need to be fed.
Take this thing back with you.
That's not enough to trade for anything.
I'm watching your hand, not it.
You ran into my tail.
I pulled my tail back at once.
You were thrown back half a step.
My scales clattered from the impact.
I didn't go down one bit.

lines.zh: 你的手碰到了我的手臂。
lines.en: Your hand met my arm.

lines.zh: 尾巴碰到你，我立刻收住。
lines.en: My tail touches you, and I pull it back at once.
Sand kicked up from the floor.
I drew back slowly.
That left me rather displeased.
I rule this stretch as well.
You needn't stand so close.
Coiled together we'd still be cold.
This cave has room for two.
Your scales are darker than mine.
Let's guard this stone door together.
I won't trust you first.
Taking one side each is enough.
Neither of us needs to speak.
Consider that agreed, then.
I pick up a piece of bone.

lines.zh: 我嫌这玩意儿磨牙都软。
lines.en: This thing's too soft even to gnaw on.
I lift it on a fingertip.
You dropped it — take it back.

lines.zh: 我用指甲挑起它看了看。
lines.en: I lift it on a fingernail and look it over.
The cold stone rests against my palm.
I set it back on the stone.
This one is really too small.
It's dusted over with dirt.
I looked at it and let it go.
You've raised your torch.
I glide slowly toward your side.
I know this floor well.

lines.zh: 沙咬住你的脚踝，我看清了。
lines.en: The sand has your ankle—I see it clearly.
Your position is fixed.
My tail has already curved around.
You've backed against the rock wall.
That passage only opens at one end.

lines.zh: 你的脚步一乱，我就笑了。
lines.en: Your steps falter, and I smile.
I lift a hand to smooth my hair.
You've pressed your back to the stone.
That stone must feel cold.
I've drawn closer slowly.
You back away with the torch up.

lines.zh: 火把把我们的影子连起来。
lines.en: The torch stretches our shadows into one.
Right at this very instant.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在地上划了一道。
lines.en: My tail drew a line on the floor.
Where do you think you can run?
I'm in the stone shadow at your left.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴已经绕到你身后。
lines.en: My tail has curled behind you.
Do you hear scales on stone?
I come slowly along the wall.
Your torch doesn't reach this far.

lines.zh: 别退了，我的蛇身比你腿长。
lines.en: Stop backing away; my serpent body is longer than your legs.

lines.zh: 地面上的沙越来越少了。
lines.en: There's less and less sand on the floor.

lines.zh: 我看你握火把的手在抖。
lines.en: I see the hand on your torch trembling.
Counting the flagstones, three are left.
I lower my upper body slightly.
My hair brushes the stone.
Your breathing is growing thick.
I've reached my hand out slowly.

lines.zh: 你回头那一眼，我记住了。
lines.en: I'll remember that glance you cast back.
The torchlight flickers on your face.

lines.zh: 你侧过头就能看见我的发。
lines.en: Turn your head and you'll see my hair.
I've sealed the last way out.
This is the place.
I watch your trembling flame.

lines.zh: 我听见你咽了一下口水。
lines.en: I heard you swallow.
My hand closes on your shoulder.
My tail whips across.
The sweep threw you back a few paces.
My nails are very sharp.
You blocked it, and your wrist went numb.
I slipped around behind you.
The rock wall stopped your retreat.
That was quick and light.
You caught hold of my hair.
One toss of my head and I was free.
Your hand came off your weapon.
I stepped back and watched you.
There's no mark on your armor.
But you can't stand steady now.
I'll close in once more.
Do you want me to stop?

lines.zh: 我的尾巴横在了你身前。
lines.en: My tail lies across your path.
This is enough.
You've backed to where there's no more room.
I drew my hand back.
I slide out of the depths of the crevice.
The air in the cave is dry.
Fine sand covers my scales.
I coil my tail slowly.
The rock overhead is low.
I hear footsteps coming in.

lines.zh: 我从石壁后滑出半个身。
lines.en: I slide half my body out from behind the wall.

lines.zh: 我停在光与暗的交界处。
lines.en: I stop where light meets shadow.
I rest a hand on the rock wall.
This stone passage leads down.
I'll stay right here.
Old bones lie underfoot.
The fire singed my hair.
I fell from the stone ledge.

lines.zh: 水呛进我的肺，又冷又沉。
lines.en: Water chokes into my lungs, cold and heavy.
The blast threw me against the rock.

lines.zh: 箭杆还颤在我的尾鳞上。
lines.en: The arrow shaft still quivers in my tail scales.
Spellforce bores along my scale seams.

lines.zh: 这地下没有能吃的东西。
lines.en: There's nothing to eat down here.
The lightning lit the whole passage.

lines.zh: 虚空里连我的尾巴都无处缠。
lines.en: In the void there is nothing for my tail to coil around.
